units.summary: Turns stale-series collection into a generic filter that takes any postings plus an optional predicate (run under the series lock), and returns the kept refs in input order and sorted by labels. CompactSelectedSeries now feeds it caller-supplied refs, so the input is no longer guaranteed to be sorted and unique the way AllPostings was.

issues.title: Duplicate input refs are not deduplicated, so the block write fails
issues.evidence:
sortedByRef = append(sortedByRef, ref)
		keptSeries = append(keptSeries, s)
issues.failure_scenario: CompactSelectedSeries([]SeriesRef{r, r}) puts series r into sortedByLabels twice. When the block is written, the index writer gets the same label set twice in a row; upstream Prometheus's writer rejects that as an out-of-order series, so the compaction fails and the series is never evicted.

issues.title: sortedByRef is no longer sorted, but Intersect callers assume sorted
issues.evidence: //   - sortedByRef preserves the order of the input postings
issues.failure_scenario: With unsorted caller refs, Postings for a non-AllPostings key and PostingsForLabelMatching build ListPostings from sortedByRef and pass it to index.Intersect. Intersect expects sorted postings and silently skips matches. Today only compaction uses these readers, and it calls only AllPostings.
